data.one_liner: Extracts Open Graph protocol metadata and favicons from web pages.
data.what_it_does: Extracts Open Graph metadata items like titles, descriptions, images, and geolocation fields from HTML web pages or raw HTML documents. It also provides functionality to fetch favicon URLs.
use_when: You need to extract Open Graph metadata from URLs for link previews.
You want to fetch all available favicon URLs from a webpage.
avoid_when: You need a complex web scraper or full DOM manipulation library beyond metadata extraction.
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of Open Graph protocol fields.
weaknesses: Limited strictly to Open Graph and favicon extraction.
Depends on the structure and presence of meta tags on target web pages.
